headings.title: صَبْرُ الرَّسُولِ عَلَى إيذَاءِ الْمُشْرِكِينَ
headings.title_en: The Messenger’s patience in the face of the polytheists’ harm

headings.title: طَمَعُ الْمُشْرِكِينَ فِي الرَّسُولِ بَعْدَ وَفَاةِ أَبِي طَالِبٍ وَخَدِيجَةَ
headings.title_en: The polytheists becoming emboldened against the Messenger after the death of Abū Ṭālib and Khadījah

headings.title: الْمُشْرِكُونَ عِنْدَ أَبِي طَالِبٍ لَمَّا ثَقُلَ بِهِ الْمَرَضُ يَطْلُبُونَ عَهْدًا بَيْنَهُمْ وَبَيْنَ الرَّسُولِ
headings.title_en: The polytheists in the presence of Abū Ṭālib, when his illness became severe, seeking an agreement between them and the Messenger

headings.title: طَمَعُ الرَّسُولِ فِي إسْلَامِ أَبِي طَالِبٍ وَحَدِيثُ ذَلِكَ
headings.title_en: The Messenger’s hope that Abū Ṭālib would accept Islam

headings.title: مَا نَزَلَ فِيمَنْ طَلَبُوا الْعَهْدَ عَلَى الرَّسُولِ عِنْدَ أَبِي طَالِبٍ
headings.title_en: What was revealed concerning those who sought an agreement binding the Messenger in the presence of Abū Ṭālib

headings.title: سَعْيُ الرَّسُولِ إلَى ثَقِيفٍ يَطْلُبُ النُّصْرَةَ
headings.title_en: The Messenger’s journey to Thaqīf seeking support

headings.title: تَوَجُّهُهُ ﷺ إلَى رَبِّهِ بِالشَّكْوَى
headings.title_en: The Prophet’s ﷺ turning to his Lord in complaint

headings.title: قِصَّةُ عَدَّاسٍ النَّصْرَانِيِّ مَعَهُ ﷺ
headings.title_en: The story of ʿAddās the Christian with him ﷺ

headings.title: أَمْرُ الْجِنِّ الَّذِينَ اسْتَمَعُوا لَهُ وَآمَنُوا بِهِ
headings.title_en: Jinn who listened to him and believed in him

headings.title: عَرْضُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ نَفْسَهُ عَلَى الْقَبَائِلِ
headings.title_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ presenting himself to the tribes

headings.title: عَرْضُ الرَّسُولِ نَفْسَهُ عَلَى الْعَرَبِ فِي الْمَوَاسِمِ
headings.title_en: The Messenger presenting himself to the Arabs during their seasonal gatherings

headings.title: سُوَيْدُ بْنُ صَامِتٍ وَرَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ
headings.title_en: Suwayd b. Ṣāmit and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ

headings.title: إسْلَامُ إيَاسِ بْنِ مُعَاذٍ وَقِصَّةُ أَبِي الْحَيْسَرِ
headings.title_en: Iyās b. Muʿādh’s acceptance of Islam and the story of Abū al-Ḥaysar

headings.title: بَدْءُ إسْلَامِ الْأَنْصَارِ
headings.title_en: The Anṣār’s first acceptance of Islam

headings.title: رَسُولُ اللَّهِ وَرَهْطٌ مِنْ الْخَزْرَجِ عِنْدَ الْعَقَبَةِ
headings.title_en: The Messenger of Allah and a group from al-Khazraj at al-ʿAqabah

headings.title: أَسَمَاءُ الرَّهْطِ الْخَزْرَجِيِّينَ الَّذِينَ الْتَقَوْا بِالرَّسُولِ عِنْدَ الْعَقَبَةِ
headings.title_en: The names of the Khazrajī group who met the Messenger at al-ʿAqabah

headings.title: الْعَقَبَةُ الْأُولَى وَمُصْعَبُ بْنُ عُمَيْرٍ
headings.title_en: The first pledge at al-ʿAqabah and Muṣʿab b. ʿUmayr

headings.title: عَهْدُ الرَّسُولِ عَلَى مُبَايِعِي الْعَقَبَةِ
headings.title_en: The Messenger’s covenant with those who gave the pledge of allegiance at al-ʿAqabah

headings.title: إرْسَالُ الرَّسُولِ مُصْعَبًا مَعَ وَفْدِ الْعَقَبَةِ
headings.title_en: The Messenger’s sending Muṣʿab with the delegation of al-ʿAqabah

headings.title: أَوَّلُ جُمُعَةٍ أَقِيمَتْ بِالْمَدِينَةِ
headings.title_en: The first Friday prayer held in Madinah

headings.title: أَمْرُ الْعَقَبَةِ الثَّانِيَةِ
headings.title_en: Second pledge at al-ʿAqabah

headings.title: الْبَرَاءُ بْنُ مَعْرُورٍ وَصَلَاتُهُ إلَى الْكَعْبَةِ
headings.title_en: Al-Barāʾ b. Maʿrūr and his prayer toward the Kaʿbah

headings.title: إسْلَامُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو
headings.title_en: ʿAbd Allāh b. ʿAmr’s acceptance of Islam
headings.note: The passage reads “ʿAbd Allāh ibn ʿAmr ibn Ḥarām or Jābir,” creating uncertainty; context later calls him Abū Jābir.

headings.title: الْعَبَّاسُ يَتَوَثَّقُ لِلنَّبِيِّ عَلَيْهِ الصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ
headings.title_en: Al-ʿAbbās seeks firm assurance for the Prophetﷺ

headings.title: عَهْدُ الرَّسُولِ عَلَيْهِ الصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلَى الْأَنْصَارِ
headings.title_en: The covenant of the Messengerﷺ, with the Anṣār

headings.title: أَسَمَاءُ النُّقَبَاءِ الِاثْنَيْ عَشَرَ وَتَمَامُ خَبَرِ الْعَقَبَةِ
headings.title_en: The names of the twelve representatives and the remaining events at al-ʿAqabah

headings.title: أَوَّلُ مَنْ ضَرَبَ عَلَى يَدِ الرَّسُولِ فِي بَيْعَةِ الْعَقَبَةِ الثَّانِيَةِ
headings.title_en: The first to clasp the Messenger’s hand in the pledge of allegiance of the second al-ʿAqabah
headings.note: The passage reports conflicting claims about who was first: Abū Umāmah Asʿad ibn Zurārah, Abū al-Haytham ibn al-Tayyihān, or al-Barāʾ ibn Maʿrūr.

headings.title: تَنْفِيرُ الشَّيْطَانِ لِمَنْ بَايَعَ فِي الْعَقَبَةِ الثَّانِيَةِ
headings.title_en: The devil’s attempt to frighten those who pledged allegiance at the second al-ʿAqabah

headings.title: غُدُوُّ قُرَيْشٍ عَلَى الْأَنْصَارِ فِي شَأْنِ الْبَيْعَةِ
headings.title_en: Quraysh’s morning visit to the Anṣār concerning the pledge of allegiance

headings.title: قِصَّةُ صَنَمِ عَمْرِو بْنِ الْجَمُوحِ
headings.title_en: The story of the idol of ʿAmr b. al-Jamūḥ

headings.title: شُرُوطُ الْبَيْعَةِ فِي الْعَقَبَةِ الْأَخِيرَةِ
headings.title_en: The conditions of the pledge of allegiance at the last al-ʿAqabah

headings.title: أَسَمَاءُ مَنْ شَهِدَ الْعَقَبَةَ
headings.title_en: The names of those who attended al-ʿAqabah

headings.title: نُزُولُ الْأَمْرِ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ فِي الْقِتَالِ
headings.title_en: The revelation of the command to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ regarding fighting

headings.title: إذْنُهُ ﷺ لِمُسْلِمِي مَكَّةَ بِالْهِجْرَةِ
headings.title_en: The Prophet’s ﷺ giving permission to the Muslims of Makkah to emigrate

headings.title: ذِكْرُ الْمُهَاجِرِينَ إلَى الْمَدِينَةِ
headings.title_en: Emigrants to Madinah

headings.title: هِجْرَةُ عُمَرَ وَقِصَّةُ عَيَّاشٍ
headings.title_en: The emigration of ʿUmar and the story of ʿAyyāsh

headings.title: مَنَازِلُ الْمُهَاجِرِينَ بِالْمَدِينَةِ
headings.title_en: The lodgings of the emigrants in Madinah

headings.title: هِجْرَةُ الرَّسُولِ ﷺ
headings.title_en: The emigration of the Messenger ﷺ

headings.title: تَأَخُّرُ عَلِيٍّ وَأَبِي بَكْرٍ فِي الْهِجْرَةِ
headings.title_en: ʿAlī and Abū Bakr remain behind before emigrating

headings.title: اجْتِمَاعُ الْمَلَأِ مِنْ قُرَيْشٍ وَتَشَاوُرُهُمْ فِي أَمْرِ الرَّسُولِ ﷺ
headings.title_en: The assembly of the chiefs of Quraysh and their consultation about the matter of the Messenger ﷺ

headings.title: خُرُوجُ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ وَاسْتِخْلَافُهُ عَلِيًّا عَلَى فِرَاشِهِ
headings.title_en: The Prophet’s ﷺ departure and his deputing ʿAlī to lie on his bed

headings.title: مَا نَزَلَ مِنْ الْقُرْآنِ فِي تَرَبُّصِ الْمُشْرِكِينَ بِالنَّبِيِّ
headings.title_en: What was revealed of the Qurʾān concerning the polytheists’ lying in wait for the Prophet

headings.title: طَمَعُ أَبِي بَكْرٍ فِي أَنْ يَكُونَ صَاحِبَ النَّبِيِّ فِي الْهِجْرَةِ وَمَا أَعَدَّ لِذَلِكَ
headings.title_en: Abū Bakr’s hope to be the Prophet’s companion in the emigration, and what he prepared for that

headings.title: حَدِيثُ هِجْرَتِهِ ﷺ إلَى الْمَدِينَةِ
headings.title_en: Prophet’s ﷺ emigration to Madinah

headings.title: مَنْ كَانَ يَعْلَمُ بِهِجْرَةِ الرَّسُولِ ﷺ
headings.title_en: Those who knew of the Messenger’s ﷺ emigration

headings.title: قِصَّةُ الرَّسُولِ ﷺ مَعَ أَبِي بَكْرٍ فِي الْغَارِ
headings.title_en: The story of the Messenger ﷺ with Abū Bakr in the cave

headings.title: خَبَرُ الْهَاتِفِ مِنْ الْجِنِّ عَنْ طَرِيقِ الرَّسُولِ ﷺ فِي هِجْرَتِهِ
headings.title_en: The report of the caller from the jinn about the route of the Messenger ﷺ in his emigration

headings.title: أَبُو قُحَافَةَ وَأَسْمَاءُ بَعْدَ هِجْرَةِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ
headings.title_en: Abū Quḥāfah and Asmāʾ after Abū Bakr’s emigration

headings.title: سُرَاقَةُ وَرُكُوبُهُ فِي أَثَرِ الرَّسُولِ ﷺ
headings.title_en: Surāqah’s mounted pursuit of the Messenger ﷺ

headings.title: طَرِيقُهُ ﷺ فِي هِجْرَتِهِ
headings.title_en: The Prophet’s ﷺ route in his emigration

headings.title: مَنَازِلُهُ ﷺ بقُباءٍ
headings.title_en: The Prophet’s ﷺ lodgings at Qubāʾ
headings.note: The passage reports differing accounts of where he lodged at Qubāʾ.

headings.title: بِنَاءُ مَسْجِدِ قُبَاءٍ
headings.title_en: The building of the mosque of Qubāʾ

headings.title: مَبْرَكَ نَاقَتهُ ﷺ بِدَارِ بَنِي مَالِكِ بْنِ النَّجَّارِ
headings.title_en: The place where the Prophet’s ﷺ she-camel knelt in the quarter of Banū Mālik b. al-Najjār

headings.title: بِنَاءُ مَسْجِدِ الْمَدِينَةِ وَمَسَاكِنِهِ ﷺ
headings.title_en: Building the mosque of Madinah and the Prophet’s ﷺ dwellings

headings.title: تَلَاحُقُ الْمُهَاجِرِينَ إلَى الرَّسُولِ ﷺ بِالْمَدِينَةِ
headings.title_en: The successive joining of the Muhājirūn with the Messenger ﷺ in Madinah

headings.title: أَوَّلُ خُطَبِهِ عَلَيْهِ الصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ
headings.title_en: The first of his sermonsﷺ

headings.title: خُطْبَتُهُ الثَّانِيَةُ ﷺ
headings.title_en: The Prophet’s ﷺ second sermon

headings.title: كِتَابُهُ ﷺ بَيْنَ الْمُهَاجِرِينَ وَالْأَنْصَارِ وَمُوَادَعَةُ يَهُودَ
headings.title_en: The Prophet’s ﷺ agreement between the emigrants and the Anṣār and his pact with the Jews

headings.title: الْمُؤَاخَاةُ بَيْنَ الْمُهَاجِرِينَ وَالْأَنْصَارِ
headings.title_en: The establishment of brotherhood between the Muhājirūn and the Anṣār

headings.title: خَبَرُ الْأَذَانِ
headings.title_en: Call to prayer (adhān)

headings.title: رُؤْيَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ فِي الْأَذَانِ
headings.title_en: ʿAbd Allāh b. Zayd’s dream about the call to prayer

headings.title: تَعْلِيمُ بِلَالٍ الْأَذَانَ
headings.title_en: Teaching Bilāl the call to prayer

headings.title: رُؤْيَا عُمَرُ فِي الْأَذَانِ وَسَبْقُ الْوَحْيِ بِهِ
headings.title_en: ʿUmar’s dream about the call to prayer and the earlier revelation concerning it

headings.title: الْأَعْدَاءُ مِنْ يَهُودَ
headings.title_en: The enemies among the Jews

headings.title: سَبَبُ عَدَاوَتِهِمْ
headings.title_en: The cause of their enmity

headings.title: إسْلَامُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ سَلَامٍ
headings.title_en: The conversion to Islam of ʿAbd Allāh b. Salām

headings.title: حَدِيثُ مُخَيْرِيقٍ
headings.title_en: Mukhayrīq

headings.title: شَهَادَةٌ عَنْ صَفِيَّةَ
headings.title_en: A testimony from Ṣafiyyah

headings.title: مِنْ اجْتَمَعَ إلَى يَهُودَ مِنْ مُنَافِقِي الْأَنْصَارِ
headings.title_en: Those of the hypocrites of the Anṣār who joined the Jews

headings.title: مَنْ أَسْلَمَ مِنْ أَحْبَارِ يَهُودَ نِفَاقًا
headings.title_en: Those Jewish rabbis who embraced Islam hypocritically

headings.title: مَا نَزَلَ مِنْ الْبَقَرَةِ فِي الْمُنَافِقِينَ وَيَهُودَ
headings.title_en: What was revealed from al-Baqarah concerning the hypocrites and the Jews

headings.title: مَا نَزَلَ فِي مُنَافِقِي الْأَوْسِ وَالْخَزْرَجِ
headings.title_en: What was revealed concerning the hypocrites of al-Aws and al-Khazraj

headings.title: دَعْوَى الْيَهُودَ قِلَّةَ الْعَذَابِ فِي الْآخِرَةِ وَرَدُّ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِمْ
headings.title_en: The Jews’ claim that punishment in the Hereafter would be brief, and Allah’s response to them

headings.title: سُؤَالُ الْيَهُودِ الرَّسُولَ وَإِجَابَتُهُ لَهُمْ عَلَيْهِ الصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ
headings.title_en: The Jews’ questioning of the Messenger and his answer to themﷺ

headings.title: إنْكَارُ الْيَهُودِ نُبُوَّةَ دَاوُدَ - عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ - وَرَدُّ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِمْ
headings.title_en: The Jews’ denial of the prophethood of Dāwūd (peace be upon him) and Allah’s response to them
headings.note: The passage discusses some Jewish rabbis denying the prophethood of Sulaymān ibn Dāwūd, not Dāwūd.

headings.title: كِتَابُهُ ﷺ إلَى يَهُودِ خَيْبَرَ
headings.title_en: The Prophet’s ﷺ letter to the Jews of Khaybar

headings.title: مَا نَزَلَ فِي أَبِي يَاسِرٍ وَأَخِيهِ
headings.title_en: What was revealed concerning Abū Yāsir and his brother Ḥuyayy b. Akhṭab

headings.title: كُفْرُ الْيَهُودِ بِهِ ﷺ بَعْدَ اسْتِفْتَاحِهِمْ بِهِ وَمَا نَزَلَ فِي ذَلِكَ
headings.title_en: The Jews’ disbelief in the Prophet ﷺ after they had sought victory through him, and what was revealed concerning that

headings.title: مَا نَزَلَ فِي نُكْرَانِ مَالِكِ بْنِ الصَّيْفِ الْعَهْدَ إلَيْهِمْ بِالنَّبِيِّ
headings.title_en: What was revealed concerning Mālik b. al-Ṣayf’s denial of the covenant given to them concerning the Prophet

headings.title: مَا نَزَلَ فِي قَوْلِ أَبِي صَلُوبا مَا جِئْتنَا بِشَيْءٍ نَعْرِفُهُ
headings.title_en: What was revealed concerning Abū Ṣalūbā’s statement, “You have brought us nothing we recognize”

headings.title: مَا نَزَلَ فِي قَوْلِ ابْنِ حُرَيْمِلَةَ وَوَهْبٍ
headings.title_en: What was revealed concerning the statement of Rāfiʿ b. Ḥuraymilah and Wahb b. Zayd

headings.title: مَا نَزَلَ فِي صَدِّ حُيَيٍّ وَأَخِيهِ النَّاسَ عَنْ الْإِسْلَامِ
headings.title_en: What was revealed concerning Ḥuyayy b. Akhṭab and his brother Abū Yāsir b. Akhṭab turning people away from Islam

headings.title: تَنَازُعُ الْيَهُودِ وَالنَّصَارَى عِنْدَ الرَّسُولِ ﷺ
headings.title_en: The Jews and the Christians disputing before the Messenger ﷺ

headings.title: مَا نَزَلَ فِي طَلَبِ ابْنِ حُرَيْمِلَةَ أَنْ يُكَلِّمَهُ اللَّهُ
headings.title_en: What was revealed concerning Rāfiʿ b. Ḥuraymilah’s request that Allah speak to him
headings.note: The heading says “to him,” while the passage has the request as “to us.”

headings.title: مَا نَزَلَ فِي سُؤَالِ ابْنِ صُورِيَّا لِلنَّبِيِّ عَلَيْهِ الصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ بِأَنْ يَتَهَوَّدَ
headings.title_en: What was revealed concerning ʿAbd Allāh b. Ṣūriyā’s request to the Prophet ﷺ that he become Jewish

headings.title: مَقَالَةُ الْيَهُودِ عِنْدَ صَرْفِ الْقِبْلَةِ إلَى الْكَعْبَةِ
headings.title_en: The Jews’ statement when the qiblah was turned toward the Kaʿbah

headings.title: اخْتِلَافُ الْيَهُودِ وَالنَّصَارَى فِي إبْرَاهِيمَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ
headings.title_en: The disagreement of the Jews and Christians concerning Ibrāhīm (peace be upon him)

headings.title: النَّفَرُ الَّذِينَ حَزَّبُوا الْأَحْزَابَ
headings.title_en: The group who rallied the confederates

headings.title_en: Brief notices concerning the hypocrites

headings.title_en: Those among the Companions of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ who fell ill

headings.title: دُعَاءُ الرَّسُولِ ﷺ بِنَقْلِ وَبَاءِ الْمَدِينَةِ إلَى مَهْيَعَةَ

headings.title_en: ʿUbaydah b. al-Ḥārith’s detachment, the first for which the Prophet ﷺ appointed a standard-bearer
headings.note: The Arabic heading has a spacing irregularity in الصلاة.

headings.title_en: Ḥamzah’s detachment to the seacoast

headings.title: غَزْوَةُ بُوَاطٍ
headings.title_en: The expedition to Buwāṭ

headings.title: غَزْوَةُ الْعَشِيرَةِ
headings.title_en: The expedition of al-ʿUshayrah

headings.title: سَرِيَّةُ سَعْدِ بْنِ أَبِي وَقَّاصٍ

headings.title_en: The departure of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ

headings.title_en: The two banners of the Messenger ﷺ

headings.title: عَدَدُ إبِلِ الْمُسْلِمِينَ
headings.title_en: The number of the Muslims’ camels

headings.title: طَرِيقُ الْمُسْلِمِينَ إلَى بَدْرٍ
headings.title_en: The Muslims’ route to Badr

headings.title_en: Abū Bakr, ʿUmar, and al-Miqdād, and their words concerning jihād

headings.title_en: The Messenger ﷺ seeks assurance of the Anṣār’s support

headings.title: الرَّسُولُ ﷺ وَأَبُو بَكْرٍ يَتَعَرَّفَانِ أَخْبَارَ قُرَيْشٍ

headings.title_en: Al-Ḥubāb’s counsel to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ

headings.title: بِنَاءُ الْعَرِيشِ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ
headings.title_en: Building the shelter for the Messenger of Allah ﷺ

headings.title: ارْتِحَالُ قُرَيْشٍ
headings.title_en: Quraysh’s departure

headings.title_en: Quraysh’s consultation about turning back from the fighting

headings.title: دُعَاءُ عُتْبَةَ إلَى الْمُبَارَزَةِ
headings.title_en: ʿUtbah’s call to single combat

headings.title: الْتِقَاءُ الْفَرِيقَيْنِ
headings.title_en: The meeting of the two sides

headings.title: ابْنُ غَزِيَّةَ وَضَرْبُ الرَّسُولِ لَهُ فِي بَطْنِهِ بِالْقَدَحِ

headings.title_en: The Messenger’s imploring his Lord for victory

headings.title: مَقْتَلُ أُمَيَّةَ بْنِ خَلَفٍ
headings.title_en: The killing of Umayyah b. Khalaf

headings.title: شُهُودُ الْمَلَائِكَةِ وَقْعَةَ بَدْرٍ
headings.title_en: The angels’ presence at the battle of Badr

headings.title: مَقْتَلُ أَبِي جَهْلٍ
headings.title_en: The killing of Abū Jahl

headings.title: شِعَارُ الْمُسْلِمِينَ بِبَدْرِ
headings.title_en: The Muslims’ battle cry at Badr

headings.title: قِصَّةُ سَيْفِ عُكَّاشَةَ
headings.title_en: ʿUkkāshah’s sword

headings.title: طَرْحُ الْمُشْرِكِينَ فِي الْقَلِيبِ
headings.title_en: Throwing the polytheists into the well

headings.title_en: The return of the Messenger of Allah from Badr

headings.title_en: The killing of al-Naḍr and ʿUqbah

headings.title_en: The news of Quraysh’s calamity reaches Makkah

headings.title_en: Quraysh’s lamentation over their slain

headings.title: أَمْرُ سُهَيْلِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو وَفِدَاؤُهُ
headings.title_en: Suhayl b. ʿAmr and his ransom

headings.title: أَسْرُ عَمْرِو بْنِ أَبِي سُفْيَانَ وَإِطْلَاقُهُ
headings.title_en: The capture of ʿAmr b. Abī Sufyān and his release

headings.title: أَسْرُ أَبِي الْعَاصِ بْنِ الرَّبِيعِ
headings.title_en: The capture of Abū al-ʿĀṣ b. al-Rabīʿ

headings.title_en: Abū al-ʿĀṣ before the Messenger and Zaynab’s payment for his ransom

headings.title: الرَّسُولُ يُحِلُّ دَمَ هَبَّارٍ
headings.title_en: The Messenger authorizes the killing of Habbār

headings.title: إسْلَامُ أَبِي الْعَاصِ بْنِ الرَّبِيعِ
headings.title_en: Abū al-ʿĀṣ b. al-Rabīʿ’s acceptance of Islam

headings.title: الَّذِينَ أَطْلَقُوا مِنْ غَيْرِ فِدَاءٍ
headings.title_en: Those who were released without ransom

headings.title: إسْلَامُ عُمَيْرِ بْنِ وَهْبٍ
headings.title_en: ʿUmayr b. Wahb’s acceptance of Islam

headings.title: الْمُطْعِمُونَ مِنْ قُرَيْشٍ
headings.title_en: Those of Quraysh who provided food

headings.title: أَسَمَاءُ خَيْلِ الْمُسْلِمِينَ يَوْمَ بَدْرٍ
headings.title_en: The names of the Muslims’ horses on the day of Badr

headings.title: خَيْلُ الْمُشْرِكِينَ
headings.title_en: The horses of the polytheists

headings.title: نُزُولُ سُورَةِ الْأَنْفَالِ
headings.title_en: The revelation of Sūrat al-Anfāl

headings.title: مَا نَزَلَ فِي خُرُوجِ الْقَوْمِ مَعَ الرَّسُولِ لِمُلَاقَاةِ قُرَيْشٍ
headings.title_en: What was revealed concerning the people’s going out with the Messenger to meet Quraysh

headings.title_en: What was revealed concerning the Messenger’s throwing pebbles at the polytheists

headings.title: مَا نَزَلَ فِي الِاسْتِفْتَاحِ
headings.title_en: What was revealed concerning the appeal for judgment

headings.title: مَا نَزَلَ فِي حَضِّ الْمُسْلِمِينَ عَلَى طَاعَةِ الرَّسُولِ
headings.title_en: What was revealed concerning urging the Muslims to obey the Messenger

headings.title: مَا نَزَلَ فِي ذِكْرِ نِعْمَةِ اللَّهِ عَلَى الرَّسُولِ
headings.title_en: What was revealed concerning the mention of Allah’s favor upon the Messenger

headings.title: مَا نَزَلَ فِي غِرَّةِ قُرَيْشٍ وَاسْتِفْتَاحِهِمْ

headings.title_en: The order to fight the unbelievers

headings.title: مَا نَزَلَ فِي تَقْسِيمِ الْفَيْءِ

headings.title: مَا نَزَلَ فِي الْأُسَارَى وَالْمَغَانِمِ
headings.title_en: What was revealed concerning the captives and the spoils

headings.title: قُدُومُ زَيْدِ الْخَيْلِ فِي وَفْدِ طَيِّئٍ
headings.title_en: The arrival of Zayd al-Khayl in the delegation of Ṭayyiʾ

headings.title: أَمْرُ عَدِيِّ بْنِ حَاتِمٍ
headings.title_en: ʿAdī b. Ḥātim

headings.title: أَسْرُ الرَّسُولِ ابْنَةَ حَاتِمٍ ثُمَّ إطْلَاقُهَا
headings.title_en: The Messenger’s capture of the daughter of Ḥātim and then his release of her
headings.note: The passage attributes the capture directly to cavalry of the Messenger ﷺ, while the heading ascribes it to the Messenger.

headings.title: إشَارَةُ ابْنَةِ حَاتِمٍ عَلَى عَدِيٍّ بِالْإِسْلَامِ
headings.title_en: The daughter of Ḥātim’s advising ʿAdī to accept Islam

headings.title: قُدُومُ عَدِيٍّ عَلَى الرَّسُولِ وَإِسْلَامُهُ

headings.title: قُدُومُ فَرْوَةَ بْنِ مُسَيْكٍ الْمُرَادِيَّ

headings.title: قُدُومُ عَمْرِو بْنِ مَعْدِ يَكْرِبَ فِي أُنَاسٍ مِنْ بَنِي زُبَيْدٍ
headings.title_en: The arrival of ʿAmr b. Maʿdīkarib among some people of Banū Zubayd

headings.title: قُدُومُ الْأَشْعَثِ بْنِ قَيْسٍ فِي وَفْدِ كِنْدَةَ
headings.title_en: The arrival of al-Ashʿath b. Qays in the delegation of Kindah

headings.title: قُدُومُ صُرَدَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْأَزْدِيَّ
headings.title_en: The arrival of Ṣurad b. ʿAbd Allāh al-Azdī

headings.title: قُدُومُ رَسُولِ مُلُوكِ حِمْيَرَ بِكِتَابِهِمْ
headings.title_en: The arrival of the envoy of the kings of Ḥimyar with their letter

headings.title: وَصِيَّةُ الرَّسُولِ مُعَاذًا حِينَ بَعَثَهُ إلَى الْيَمَنِ
headings.title_en: The Messenger’s counsel to Muʿādh when he sent him to Yemen

headings.title: إسْلَامُ فَرْوَةَ بْنِ عَمْرٍو الْجُذَامِيِّ

headings.title: إسْلَامُ بَنِي الْحَارِثِ بْنِ كَعْبٍ عَلَى يَدَيْ خَالِدِ بْنِ الْوَلِيدِ لَمَّا سَارَ إلَيْهِمْ

headings.title: قُدُومُ رِفَاعَةَ بْنِ زَيْدٍ الْجُذَامِيِّ
headings.title_en: The arrival of Rifāʿah b. Zayd al-Judhāmī

headings.title: قُدُومُ وَفْدِ هَمْدَانَ
headings.title_en: The arrival of the delegation of Hamdān

headings.title: ذِكْرُ الْكَذَّابَينَ مُسَيْلِمَةَ الْحَنَفِيِّ وَالْأَسْوَدِ الْعَنْسِيَّ
headings.title_en: Two liars, Musaylimah al-Ḥanafī and al-Aswad al-ʿAnsī

headings.title_en: The Messenger’s vision concerning Musaylimah al-Ḥanafī and al-Aswad al-ʿAnsī

headings.title_en: Musaylimah’s letter to the Messenger of Allah and the response to it

headings.title: حَجَّةُ الْوَدَاعِ
headings.title_en: The Farewell pilgrimage

headings.title: تَجَهُّزُ الرَّسُولُ وَاسْتِعْمَالِهِ عَلَى الْمَدِينَةِ أَبَا دُجَانَةَ

headings.title: مَا أَمَرَ بِهِ الرَّسُولُ عَائِشَةَ فِي حَيْضِهَا
headings.title_en: What the Messenger instructed ʿĀʾishah regarding her menstruation

headings.title: مُوَافَاةُ عَلِيٍّ فِي قُفُولِهِ مِنْ الْيَمَنِ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ فِي الْحَجِّ

headings.title: خُطْبَةُ الرَّسُولِ فِي حَجَّةِ الْوَدَاعِ

headings.title_en: A summary of the expeditions

headings.title: خَبَرُ غَزْوَةِ غَالِبِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ اللَّيْثِيِّ بَنِي الْمُلَوَّحِ
headings.title_en: Expedition of Ghālib b. ʿAbd Allāh al-Laythī against Banū al-Mulawwaḥ

headings.title: غَزْوَةُ زَيْدِ بْنِ حَارِثَةَ إلَى جُذَامَ
headings.title_en: The expedition of Zayd b. Ḥārithah to Judhām

headings.title: غَزْوَةُ زَيْدِ بْنِ حَارِثَةَ بَنِي فَزَارَةَ وَمُصَابُ أُمِّ قِرْفَةَ
headings.title_en: The expedition of Zayd b. Ḥārithah against Banū Fazārah and what befell Umm Qirfah

headings.title: غَزْوَةُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ رَوَاحَةَ لِقَتْلِ الْيَسِيرِ بْنِ رِزَامٍ
headings.title_en: Expedition of ʿAbd Allāh b. Rawāḥah to kill al-Yasīr b. Rizām

headings.title: غَزْوَةُ ابْنِ عَتِيكٍ خَيْبَرَ
headings.title_en: Expedition of ʿAbd Allāh b. ʿAtīk to Khaybar

headings.title: غَزْوَةُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أُنَيْسٍ لِقَتْلِ خَالِدِ بْنِ سُفْيَانَ بْنِ نُبَيْحٍ الْهُذَلِيِّ
headings.title_en: Expedition of ʿAbd Allāh b. Unays to kill Khālid b. Sufyān b. Nubayḥ al-Hudhalī

headings.title: غَزْوَةُ غَالِبِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ أَرْضَ بَنِي مُرَّةَ
headings.title_en: Expedition of Ghālib b. ʿAbd Allāh to the land of Banū Murrah

headings.title: غَزْوَةُ عَمْرِو بْنِ الْعَاصِ ذَاتَ السَّلَاسِلِ
headings.title_en: Expedition of ʿAmr b. al-ʿĀṣ to Dhāt al-Salāsil

headings.title: غَزْوَةُ ابْنِ أَبِي حَدْرَدٍ بَطْنَ إضَمَ ، وَقَتْلُ عَامِرِ بْنِ الْأَضْبَطِ الْأَشْجَعِيِّ

headings.title: غَزْوَةُ ابْنِ أَبِي حَدْرَدٍ لِقَتْلِ رِفَاعَةَ بْنِ قَيْسٍ الْجُشَمِيِّ
headings.title_en: Expedition of ʿAbd Allāh b. Abī Ḥadrad to kill Rifāʿah b. Qays al-Jushamī
headings.note: Passage gives the target as Rifāʿa ibn Qays or Qays ibn Rifāʿa.

headings.title: انْتِصَارُ الْمُسْلِمِينَ وَنَصِيبُ ابْنِ أَبِي حَدْرَدٍ مِنْ فَيْءٍ اسْتَعَانَ بِهِ عَلَى الزَّوَاجِ

headings.title: غَزْوَةُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَوْفٍ إلَى دَوْمَةِ الْجَنْدَلِ
headings.title_en: Expedition of ʿAbd al-Raḥmān b. ʿAwf to Dūmat al-Jandal

headings.title: تَأْمِيرُ ابْنِ عَوْفٍ وَاعْتِمَامُهُ
headings.title_en: The appointment of ʿAbd al-Raḥmān b. ʿAwf as commander and his wearing of the turban

headings.title: غَزْوَةُ أَبِي عُبَيْدَةَ بْنِ الْجَرَّاحِ إلَى سَيْفِ الْبَحْرِ
headings.title_en: The expedition of Abū ʿUbaydah b. al-Jarrāḥ to the seacoast

headings.title: بَعْثُ عَمْرِو بْنِ أُمَيَّةَ الضَّمْرِيَّ لِقِتَالِ أَبِي سُفْيَانَ بْنِ حَرْبٍ وَمَا صَنَعَ فِي طَرِيقِهِ
headings.title_en: The dispatch of ʿAmr b. Umayyah al-Ḍamrī to fight Abū Sufyān b. Ḥarb and what he did on his way
headings.note: Passage says he was ordered to kill Abū Sufyān; a later bracketed subheading says “his killing Abū Sufyān,” though the excerpt is truncated.

headings.title: سَرِيَّةُ زَيْدِ بْنِ حَارِثَةَ إلَى مَدْيَنَ
headings.title_en: Detachment of Zayd b. Ḥārithah to Madyan

headings.title: غَزْوَةُ عُمَيْرِ بْنِ عَدِيٍّ الْخِطْمِيِّ لِقَتْلِ عَصْمَاءَ بِنْتَ مَرْوَانَ
headings.title_en: Expedition of ʿUmayr b. ʿAdī al-Khaṭmī to kill ʿAṣmāʾ bt. Marwān

headings.title: أَسْرُ ثُمَامَةَ بْنِ أُثَالٍ الْحَنَفِيِّ وَإِسْلَامُهُ
headings.title_en: The capture of Thumāmah b. Uthāl al-Ḥanafī and his embracing Islam

headings.title: سَرِيَّةُ عَلْقَمَةَ بْنِ مُجَزِّزٍ
headings.title_en: Detachment of ʿAlqamah b. Mujazziz

headings.title: سَرِيَّةُ كُرْزِ بْنِ جَابِرٍ لِقَتْلِ الْبَجَلِيِّينَ الَّذِينَ قَتَلُوا يَسَارًا
headings.title_en: Detachment of Kurz b. Jābir to kill the Bajalī men who killed Yasār

headings.title: قَتْلُ الْبَجَلِيِّينَ وَتَنْكِيلُ الرَّسُولِ بِهِمْ
headings.title_en: The killing of the Bajalī men and the Messenger’s exemplary punishment of them

headings.title: غَزْوَةُ عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَبِي طَالِبٍ إلَى الْيَمَنِ
headings.title_en: Expedition of ʿAlī b. Abī Ṭālib to Yemen

headings.title: بَعْثُ أُسَامَةَ بْنِ زَيْدٍ إلَى أَرْضِ فِلَسْطِينَ
headings.title_en: The dispatch of Usāmah b. Zayd to the land of Palestine

headings.title: ابْتِدَاءُ شَكْوَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ
headings.title_en: The beginning of the illness of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ

headings.title_en: Prophet’s ﷺ wives

headings.title: أُمَّهَاتِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ
headings.title_en: The mothers of the believers

headings.title: زَوَاجُهُ بِخَدِيجَةَ
headings.title_en: His marriage to Khadījah

headings.title: زَوَاجُهُ بِعَائِشَةَ
headings.title_en: His marriage to ʿĀʾishah

headings.title: زَوَاجُهُ بِسَوْدَةِ
headings.title_en: His marriage to Sawdah

headings.title: زَوَاجُهُ بِزَيْنَبِ بِنْتِ جَحْشٍ
headings.title_en: His marriage to Zaynab bt. Jaḥsh

headings.title: زَوَاجُهُ بِأُمِّ سَلَمَةَ
headings.title_en: His marriage to Umm Salamah

headings.title: زَوَاجُهُ بِحَفْصَةَ
headings.title_en: His marriage to Ḥafṣah

headings.title: زَوَاجُهُ بِأُمِّ حَبِيبَةَ
headings.title_en: His marriage to Umm Ḥabībah

headings.title: زَوَاجُهُ بِجُوَيْرِيَةَ
headings.title_en: His marriage to Juwayriyah

headings.title: زَوَاجُهُ بِصَفِيَّةَ
headings.title_en: His marriage to Ṣafiyyah

headings.title: زَوَاجُهُ بِمَيْمُونَةَ
headings.title_en: His marriage to Maymūnah

headings.title: زَوَاجُهُ زَيْنَبَ بِنْتِ خُزَيْمَةَ
headings.title_en: His marriage to Zaynab bt. Khuzaymah

headings.title_en: The nursing of the Messenger of Allah in ʿĀʾishah’s house

headings.title: كَلِمَةٌ لِلنَّبِيِّ وَاخْتِصَاصُهُ أَبَا بَكْرٍ بِالذِّكْرِ

headings.title_en: The Messenger’s command to dispatch Usāmah’s expeditionary force

headings.title: دُعَاءُ الرَّسُولِ لِأُسَامَةَ بِالْإِشَارَةِ
headings.title_en: The Messenger’s supplication for Usāmah by gesture

headings.title: صَلَاةُ أَبِي بَكْرٍ بِالنَّاسِ
headings.title_en: Abū Bakr’s leading the people in prayer

headings.title_en: The day on which Allah took His Prophet

headings.title: سِوَاكُ الرَّسُولِ قُبَيْلَ الْوَفَاةِ
headings.title_en: The Messenger’s use of the tooth-stick shortly before death

headings.title_en: ʿUmar’s statement after the death of the Messenger

headings.title_en: Saqīfah of Banū Sāʿidah

headings.title_en: The division of the community

headings.title: خُطْبَةُ عُمَرَ قَبْلَ أَبِي بَكْرٍ عِنْدَ الْبَيْعَةِ الْعَامَّةِ
headings.title_en: ʿUmar’s sermon before Abū Bakr at the general pledge of allegiance

headings.title_en: The last person to have contact with the Messenger
